# SuriComAI

> SuriComAI is a proprietary prototype, written in Rust, of a decentralized network for private AI inference. It is not live: there is no public network, no wallet, no paid jobs, and no token. The repository is a reference implementation you can run locally.

Status: prototype, not production. Nothing is private against the machine running it, and the escrow contract is unaudited and not deployed. Do not use it with real secrets or real funds.

## What exists

- Sealed prompt envelope using HPKE with X-Wing (ML-KEM-768 + X25519), receipts, and proof audit
- Job escrow rules, a settlement simulator, and a reference Solidity escrow contract (unaudited, local test chain only)
- Signed model manifests and approvals that expire and can be revoked
- A local reference chat client and two independent proof verifiers (Rust and Python) sharing test vectors

## What does not exist yet

- Hardware-backed private tier (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP)
- Separate worker, relay, and attestor processes on a network
- A deployed and audited contract, a wallet, real payments, a public network, a token
